name: Browse tournaments and join with a funded demo wallet
description: Verifies a player can browse a published tournament, enter with sufficient demo funds and trigger the tournament when the target is reached.
steps: Open Discover and note an open tournament
Open My Wallet and add demo credits
Return to Discover and join the tournament until its target count is reached
Use Share app and share the Dream Game invite link
expected: The entry fee is reserved from available demo balance, the tournament changes to Live at its target and the bracket displays randomly generated pairings. The share action opens the device share sheet or copies the live app link for inviting new users.

name: Admin creates a prize tournament
covers: game catalogue excludes Chess and Checkers
description: Verifies an admin can publish a fully described prize tournament and its details remain available after refreshing.
steps: Open Admin and create a tournament with a name, game, fee, target, prize name, description and image URL
Refresh the app and return to Discover
expected: The new tournament appears with its selected game, fee, target, prize image and prize description, and a 48-hour deadline.

name: Reject invalid tournament settings and insufficient wallet funds
description: Verifies invalid tournament data and a join attempt without enough demo credits are rejected without creating an entry.
steps: Try to publish a tournament with fewer than two players or a blank prize title
Open a tournament whose entry fee exceeds the wallet balance
expected: Validation or insufficient-balance feedback is shown and no invalid tournament entry is created.

name: Display knockout rounds and public champion
description: Verifies the bracket supports odd-player balancing with a labelled house bot, records round winners, and shows the champion in the public winners section.
steps: Review matches and any clearly labelled house-bot participant
Submit one winner per match through the tournament advancement workflow
Open Winners after the final match
expected: Each round records one winner per match, advances the winners to the next round and displays the final champion and prize.

name: Cancel an entry before start and refund demo reserve
description: Verifies reserved demo entry credits are refundable before tournament start and the app blocks cancellation once live.
steps: Cancel the entry before it starts
Confirm the available demo balance is restored
Attempt cancellation after the tournament becomes live
expected: The pre-start cancellation returns the reserved demo fee and cancellation is rejected after the tournament opens.
